We need correct functional group names: "aliphatic carboxylic acid" or "aromatic carboxylic acid". For amide formation, broken functional group is "aliphatic carboxylic acid" (the acid) and formed is "amide". Let's search.


<thought>Search for amide coupling template using functional_groups_broken "aliphatic carboxylic acid" and functional_groups_formed "amide".</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
